tasks.description: Optimize front-end code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary HTTP requests and minifying CSS/JS files. Use tools like Webpack and Gzip to compress files.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Add indexing to frequently queried database tables to improve query performance. Use tools like EXPLAIN to analyze query plans and identify bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the execution time is under 500ms

tasks.description: Create a dashboard to track key performance metrics such as page load times, query execution times, and error rates. Use tools like Grafana and Prometheus to collect and visualize data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the dashboard, when the dashboard is updated, then the metrics are accurate and up-to-date

tasks.description: Migrate the backend framework to a faster alternative such as Node.js or Go. Use tools like benchmarking to compare performance and identify areas for improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a request, when the request is processed, then the response time is under 200ms

tasks.description: Identify and fix slow queries that are causing performance bottlenecks. Use tools like EXPLAIN to analyze query plans and identify areas for improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the execution time is under 200ms

tasks.description: Implement caching to reduce the number of database queries and improve performance. Use tools like Redis or Memcached to cache frequently accessed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a request, when the request is processed, then the response time is under 100ms

tasks.description: Write a script to test the performance of the application under various loads and scenarios. Use tools like JMeter or Gatling to simulate traffic and measure performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs the script, when the script is executed, then the performance metrics are accurate and up-to-date
